## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The running status line has to show the same 12-character revision that history and completion output already show; right now it shows 7 characters, which goes against its own docstring.

## Changes
The pull request adds `status(revision, attempt)` and `attempt_label(attempt)` to `app/display.py`, which produce a `Running: <revision> (attempt N)` line. It also adds tests for both functions.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Use `revision[:12]` in the running status line — For revision `0123456789abcdef…`, `status` prints `Running: 0123456 (attempt 2)` while `history` and `completed` print `0123456789ab`. The docstring at line 13 says "using the same identifier as history", and `history` uses `revision[:12]` at line 5. — Operators matching a running deployment against history or completion output see revision identifiers that don't match. — Fix: Change line 14 to `revision[:12]`, and extend `test_running_status_contains_attempt` to assert the full output string, because its `startswith`/`endswith` checks accept any revision length.
